> **Provenance-only document.** This poster-era reconstruction predates the
> complete transcriptome-wide model and is not a manuscript evidence source.
> Use `analysis/phage_uv_ecology.qmd` for the verified current analysis surface.

```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

## Scope

This notebook preserves the poster-level analysis from the
tables already available locally. It currently covers the vOTU quality/taxonomy
layer and UV/DNA-damage genome-potential summaries.

```{r load-derived}
derived_root <- params$derived_root
tables_dir <- file.path(derived_root, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(derived_root, "figures")

manifest <- read_tsv(file.path(derived_root, "poster_replication_manifest.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
votu_quality <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "votu_quality_summary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
votu_tax_groups <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "votu_high_quality_taxonomy_groups.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
votu_realm <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "votu_high_quality_realm_summary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
uv_category <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "uv_signature_category_rollup.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
uv_mag <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "uv_signature_mag_rollup.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Generated Artifacts

```{r manifest}
manifest %>%
  mutate(path = basename(path)) %>%
  kable()
```

## vOTU Quality

```{r votu-quality-table}
votu_quality %>%
  arrange(desc(n_votus)) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r votu-quality-figure, out.width="80%"}
include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, "votu_quality_distribution.png"))
```

## High-Quality vOTU Taxonomy

```{r votu-taxonomy-summary}
votu_realm %>%
  arrange(desc(n_votus)) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r votu-realm-figure, out.width="80%"}
include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, "votu_high_quality_realm_summary.png"))
```

```{r votu-tree-figure, out.width="100%"}
include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, "votu_high_quality_taxonomy_tree.png"))
```

```{r dominant-votu-groups}
votu_tax_groups %>%
  select(vOTU_group, realm, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, n_votus, n_cluster_members) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_votus), desc(n_cluster_members)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  kable()
```

## UV Signature Potential

```{r uv-category-table}
uv_category %>%
  arrange(signature_tier, desc(n_unique_signature_symbols)) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r uv-category-figure, out.width="80%"}
include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, "uv_signature_category_rollup.png"))
```

```{r uv-mag-table}
uv_mag %>%
  arrange(desc(n_unique_signature_symbols), desc(n_signature_gene_rows)) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  kable()
```
